items.title: 30.4.2 High-resolution 1H NMR aur peaks ki splitting (batna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.4.2 with Quick Check 30.3 answered (PDF 207-209). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Protons ke NMR signals par sirf qareeb ke electrons hi asar nahi dalte, balke saath wale (adjacent) atoms par lage protons bhi asar dalte hain. Yeh asar high-resolution NMR mein nazar aata hai. Jab kisi molecule ka high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum dekha jaye to aksar har peak chhoti chhoti peaks (sub-peaks) ka cluster (guchha) hoti hai. Aisa is liye hota hai ke saath wale carbon atoms par lage protons (¹H) har signal ko split kar (baant) dete hain.

blocks.title: Splitting of signals (signals ka batna)
blocks.text: Signals ka kai peaks (jaise doublet, triplet, quartet) mein batna batata hai ke saath wale (parosi) carbon atom par kitne protons (¹H) hain.
Sub-peaks ka number 'n+1' rule se nikalta hai. Aik signal aam taur par n+1 sub-peaks mein bat jata hai, jahan n saath wale carbon atoms par protons ka number hai.
(Yahan n = saath wale carbon atom par protons ka number.)

Ethanol ke high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum mein -CH₃ ki peak teen sub-peaks (triplet) mein bat jati hai, kyunke saath wale carbon par 2 protons hain (2+1=3). Isi tarah -CH₂- ki peak chaar sub-peaks (quartet) mein bat jati hai, kyunke us ke saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain (3+1=4). -OH ka signal nahi bat'ta, kyunke yeh hydrogen carbon ki bajaye oxygen atom se jura hai (Figure 30.5).

blocks.alt: High-resolution spectrum, scale 9 se 0, formula CH3 - CH2 - OH. Taqreeban 5.4 par aik lambi akeli peak (1H), taqreeban 3.6 par chaar sub-peaks ka group (2H), aur taqreeban 1.2 par teen sub-peaks (3H).
blocks.caption: Figure 30.5: Ethanol ka high-resolution 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.5 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CH₂ ki peak (3H wale CH₃ ki wajah se) chaar sub-peaks (quartet) mein aur CH₃ ki peak (2H wale CH₂ ki wajah se) teen sub-peaks (triplet) mein bat gayi hai; O-H aik singlet hai. Labels 1H, 2H, 3H har peak ke protons ka number batate hain.

Yaad rahe ke -OH aur -NH protons aam taur par nahi bat'te, is liye singlet peak ki shakal mein aate hain. Isi tarah chemically equivalent protons apne parosi protons ko nahi baant'te. Misal: ethane (CH₃-CH₃) mein do methyl groups aapas mein jure hain. Aik methyl group ko dekhein to us ke saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain, phir bhi peak nahi bat'ti, kyunke ethane ke tamam hydrogen atoms chemically equivalent hain (Figure 30.6).

blocks.alt: Scale 3 se 0, formula H3C-CH3, aur taqreeban 0.9 par aik sharp, unsplit (na bati hui) peak.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.6: Ethane ka high-resolution 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Table 30.2 mein neighbouring (parosi) protons ke different number ke liye sub-peaks ka number aur un ki shakal di gayi hai; is se high-resolution ¹H NMR spectra mein splitting patterns (batne ke namoone) pehchanne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.caption: Table 30.2 High-resolution ¹H NMR spectra mein common splitting patterns (batne ke aam namoone)

blocks.alt: Table 30.2 ki bati peaks ki shakal: aik peak (singlet, s, n = 0), do barabar peaks (doublet, d, n = 1), teen peaks jin mein beech wali sab se lambi (triplet, t, n = 2), aur chaar peaks jin mein andar wali do sab se lambi (quartet, q, n = 3).
blocks.caption: Table 30.2, Appearance of Split Peak (bati hui peak ki shakal) (Table 30.2 mein chhapi shapes ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sub-peaks ki heights ka ratio: doublet 1:1, triplet 1:2:1, quartet 1:3:3:1. n saath wale carbon ke protons hain; sub-peaks n + 1 hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: a) ¹H NMR spectrum mein aik signal quartet hai. Kitne saath wale, barabar protons ('n') hain?
b) In compounds ke high-resolution spectra mein har signal ke kitne sub-peaks honge? i) butan-2-ol ii) 1-chloropropane iii) propanone iv) 2,2-dimethylpropane v) methanol
blocks.explanation: i) CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃: C1 ka CH₃ doublet; C2 ka H chhe sub-peaks (5 parosi H); CH₂ paanch sub-peaks (4 parosi H); C4 ka CH₃ triplet; OH singlet. ii) ClCH₂CH₂CH₃: CH₂Cl triplet; beech wala CH₂ chhe sub-peaks (5 parosi H); CH₃ triplet. iii) Propanone: aik singlet. iv) 2,2-dimethylpropane: aik singlet. v) Methanol: CH₃ singlet aur OH singlet.

items: n + 1 rule: saath wale carbon ke n protons signal ko n + 1 sub-peaks mein split karte (baant'te) hain.
OH aur NH aam taur par singlet; chemically equivalent protons aik doosre ko split nahi karte.
